name: Banner
intent: Page- or section-level contextual message (system insight, warning, or action prompt) with an optional inline action and dismiss.
when: Surface a persistent system status at the top of a page or section
Prompt the user to act on a warning or insight
Show a dismissible advisory above content

chooseOver.because: Alert is a compact inline notice; Banner is a fuller page/section header with title, optional item list, an action button, and dismiss
toasts are transient and auto-dismiss; Banner persists until the user dismisses it

commonMistakes.symptom: A persistent banner where an auto-dismissing toast was expected
commonMistakes.fix: Use Sonner for messages that should auto-dismiss
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use Banner for transient feedback — use Sonner for messages that should auto-dismiss

usage: Use Banner to communicate important information, status updates, or feedback to users. This component is designed to draw attention to messages that require user awareness or action.

Banner works well for transient notifications, validation messages, and system status indicators. Avoid using it for content that should persist on the page or for non-critical information that doesn't require immediate attention.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
